decisions.decision: Use a light, editorial product-storytelling system with near-black typography, off-white surfaces, subtle agricultural green accents, generous whitespace, and real field imagery as the primary visual language.
Use minimal hero, floating navigation, bento use-case cards, and product showcase patterns adapted to GeoHarvest rather than copying a single component.
Preserve editorial layout, use the original Figma leaf logo and local photography, reduce landing to eight sections, clearly identify synthetic data, and connect role-specific demo entry.
decisions.source: GeoHarvest master brief and implementation audit, 2026-09-16

decisions.decision: Commercial refresh: agricultural photo hero, evergreen and lime palette, early role solutions, real product screenshots in accessible tabs, mobile proof and pilot contact. Preserve original logo and label demo data.
